title: 隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿
summary: 本課以以掌子面擠出、玻纖筋黏結與開挖保留長度控制面補強為主線，從掌子面擠出與地層核心與補強密度與非均勻分擔建立系統邊界，再把開挖進尺與保留長度、施工時間與黏結成熟連到面補強與周邊支護協調。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on control face reinforcement through extrusion, fibre-bar bond and retained length. It begins with Face extrusion and ground core and Reinforcement density and unequal sharing, links Advance and retained reinforcement and Construction time and bond maturity, and ends with Face reinforcement and peripheral support. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查掌子面擠出與地層核心：meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent；再獨立檢查補強密度與非均勻分擔：tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar。同一 6000 mm 參考長度內，假想擠出由 12 增為 18 mm，平均變形比由 0.2% 增為 0.3%；不是每支筋的相同應變。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 將比較深淺錨點相對位移及通道完整性診斷作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Face extrusion and ground core: meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent. Independently check Reinforcement density and unequal sharing: tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar. Over a 6000 mm reference length, extrusion rising from 12 to 18 mm changes the mean deformation ratio from 0.2% to 0.3%; this is not identical strain in every bar. The two results are not a complete design because fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. Use compare relative shallow-deep movement and channel-integrity diagnostics as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「掌子面擠出與地層核心」與「補強密度與非均勻分擔」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 掌子面擠出與地層核心：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Face extrusion and ground core: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「掌子面擠出與地層核心」如何影響隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Face extrusion and ground core” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 面前地層向開挖空間擠出會削弱拱效應，補強筋透過黏結抑制核心變形。量到的面位移包含開挖卸載與地層時效，不能直接當作每根筋伸長；應先定義量測參考長度及未擾動基準，再比較不同進尺的擠出增量。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時；若出現基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「掌子面擠出與地層核心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ground extruding toward the opening weakens arching, while bonded bars restrain the core. Face movement includes unloading and time effects rather than each bar's extension. Define reference length and an undisturbed datum before comparing extrusion increments at different excavation advances. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. If a datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Face extrusion and ground core” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「面位移除以長度就是每支玻纖筋的真實應變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 掌子面擠出與地層核心：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Face extrusion and ground core: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「掌子面擠出與地層核心」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Face extrusion and ground core” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 掌子面擠出與地層核心：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Face extrusion and ground core: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「掌子面擠出與地層核心」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Face extrusion and ground core” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 掌子面擠出與地層核心：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Face extrusion and ground core: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「掌子面擠出與地層核心」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Face extrusion and ground core” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Face movement divided by length equals the actual strain of every bar" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fibre material and brittle tension" and "Bore-wall bond and effective anchorage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 玻纖材料與脆性拉伸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fibre material and brittle tension: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」如何影響隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fibre material and brittle tension” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 玻纖複材沿纖維方向強度高，但橫向、彎曲及剪切性能不同，不能套用鋼材的屈服延性。接頭及表面肋形也影響有效承載，名義拉力應以材證與試驗方向配對；沒有明顯塑性警訊時，損傷辨識尤其依賴品質證據。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷；若出現運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fibre composites are strong along fibres but differ in transverse, bending and shear behaviour, so steel yielding assumptions do not apply. Connections and surface ribs affect effective resistance. Match certificates to test direction; limited plastic warning makes quality evidence particularly important. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check longitudinal tension tests, connection type and installed surface damage. If handling bends break local fibres and cause sudden rupture despite a normal diameter, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fibre material and brittle tension” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Nt=A*ft=500 mm2*600 N/mm2=300000 N=300 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Nt=A*ft=500 mm2*600 N/mm2=300000 N=300 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「玻纖筋能像鋼筋一樣先大幅屈服才破壞」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fibre bar yields extensively like steel before it fails" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fibre material and brittle tension”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 玻纖材料與脆性拉伸
knowledge.text: 玻纖複材沿纖維方向強度高，但橫向、彎曲及剪切性能不同，不能套用鋼材的屈服延性。接頭及表面肋形也影響有效承載，名義拉力應以材證與試驗方向配對；沒有明顯塑性警訊時，損傷辨識尤其依賴品質證據。
knowledge.textEn: Fibre composites are strong along fibres but differ in transverse, bending and shear behaviour, so steel yielding assumptions do not apply. Connections and surface ribs affect effective resistance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：玻纖筋能像鋼筋一樣先大幅屈服才破壞 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A fibre bar yields extensively like steel before it fails Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fibre material and brittle tension" is correct?
options: 玻纖複材沿纖維方向強度高，但橫向、彎曲及剪切性能不同，不能套用鋼材的屈服延性。
玻纖筋能像鋼筋一樣先大幅屈服才破壞
只要玻纖筋本身夠強就不會發生拔出
optionsEn: Fibre composites are strong along fibres but differ in transverse, bending and shear behaviour, so steel yielding assumptions do not apply.
A fibre bar yields extensively like steel before it fails
A sufficiently strong fibre bar cannot pull out of the ground
quiz.explanation: 玻纖複材沿纖維方向強度高，但橫向、彎曲及剪切性能不同，不能套用鋼材的屈服延性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fibre composites are strong along fibres but differ in transverse, bending and shear behaviour, so steel yielding assumptions do not apply. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 玻纖材料與脆性拉伸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fibre material and brittle tension: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fibre material and brittle tension” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Nt=A*ft=500 mm2*600 N/mm2=300000 N=300 kN。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Nt=A*ft=500 mm2*600 N/mm2=300000 N=300 kN. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check longitudinal tension tests, connection type and installed surface damage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Nt=A*ft=500 mm2*600 N/mm2=300000 N=300 kN。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Nt=A*ft=500 mm2*600 N/mm2=300000 N=300 kN. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fibre material and brittle tension", which statement holds?
options: 孔口位置正確就代表深部補強位置一定正確
原創教學假設：Nt=A*ft=500 mm2*600 N/mm2=300000 N=300 kN。
掌子面中心位移小就代表整個核心沒有剪切
optionsEn: Correct collar positions guarantee correct deep reinforcement positions
Original teaching assumptions: Nt=A*ft=500 mm2*600 N/mm2=300000 N=300 kN.
Small central face movement proves the entire core is free of shear
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Nt=A*ft=500 mm2*600 N/mm2=300000 N=300 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Nt=A*ft=500 mm2*600 N/mm2=300000 N=300 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 玻纖材料與脆性拉伸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fibre material and brittle tension: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fibre material and brittle tension” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check longitudinal tension tests, connection type and installed surface damage. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Handling bends break local fibres and cause sudden rupture despite a normal diameter. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check longitudinal tension tests, connection type and installed surface damage. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If handling bends break local fibres and cause sudden rupture despite a normal diameter, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Handling bends break local fibres and cause sudden rupture despite a normal diameter. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check longitudinal tension tests, connection type and installed surface damage. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Handling bends break local fibres and cause sudden rupture despite a normal diameter. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If handling bends break local fibres and cause sudden rupture despite a normal diameter, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fibre material and brittle tension"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
掌子面位移受控就能證明所有周邊支護都安全
核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Controlled face movement proves every peripheral support element is safe
Check longitudinal tension tests, connection type and installed surface damage.
quiz.explanation: 核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check longitudinal tension tests, connection type and installed surface damage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 玻纖材料與脆性拉伸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fibre material and brittle tension: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fibre material and brittle tension” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Handling bends break local fibres and cause sudden rupture despite a normal diameter. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check longitudinal tension tests, connection type and installed surface damage to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷；若出現運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If handling bends break local fibres and cause sudden rupture despite a normal diameter, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「玻纖筋能像鋼筋一樣先大幅屈服才破壞」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fibre bar yields extensively like steel before it fails" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Handling bends break local fibres and cause sudden rupture despite a normal diameter. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check longitudinal tension tests, connection type and installed surface damage to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fibre material and brittle tension" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要玻纖筋本身夠強就不會發生拔出
optionsEn: Handling bends break local fibres and cause sudden rupture despite a normal diameter.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A sufficiently strong fibre bar cannot pull out of the ground
quiz.explanation: 運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Handling bends break local fibres and cause sudden rupture despite a normal diameter. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 孔壁黏結與有效錨固：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bore-wall bond and effective anchorage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔壁黏結與有效錨固」如何影響隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bore-wall bond and effective anchorage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 玻纖筋透過漿體將拉力分散到孔壁，實際界面受孔壁擾動及注漿連續性控制。長度增加不保證線性增加容量，受拉端先動員且可能先軟化；平均黏結公式只能用作初步量級，必須配合拉拔曲線辨認滑移位置。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以拉拔位移、灌漿量和孔壁條件共同判斷有效黏結；若出現軟弱孔壁剪壞使筋連漿拔出，提高筋強度無法解決，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔壁黏結與有效錨固」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 以拉拔位移、灌漿量和孔壁條件共同判斷有效黏結。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「軟弱孔壁剪壞使筋連漿拔出，提高筋強度無法解決」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 開挖進尺與保留長度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Advance and retained reinforcement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「開挖進尺與保留長度」如何影響隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Advance and retained reinforcement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每次開挖會切去靠近面的一段筋，剩餘錨固長度隨進尺降低。原始孔長合格不代表下一循環仍有足夠保留量，偏斜和孔底未填也會減少有效段；應建立每一輪補強與實際進尺的幾何帳，而非只記採購長度。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐輪比較實測孔長、累積進尺及下一輪補強位置；若出現超進尺把有效黏結段切短，局部擠出突然加快，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「開挖進尺與保留長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each advance removes the near-face section, reducing retained anchorage. Correct original length does not guarantee the next cycle's effective embedment; deviation and unfilled ends reduce it further.
